attributes.name: post wrapper element
attributes.definition: The semantic HTML element used to wrap each post/entry in a listing.

values.definition: Each post is wrapped in an article element.
Posts are wrapped in div, li, or another non-article element.

attributes.name: post listing layout
attributes.definition: How individual posts are visually arranged in a listing.

values.definition: Posts are single-line rows separated by dividers, with title and author placed on opposite sides.
Posts are displayed as cards or in a grid.
Posts are stacked entries without dividers or cards.
